boundary_boot.label: Launch boundary
boundary_boot.summary: Starts llama.cpp and installs one shared NovaRuntime before attaching the chat application. Launch utilities are shown only at their connection to the body.
notes: The launcher also attaches console/synchronization/guardian tools. Their internals remain PLUCK-exempt; the console hub fallback is :8799. See the launch source for these attachment points.

boundary_chat.label: Chat attachment
boundary_chat.summary: Receives messages, assembles file and memory context, passes generation callbacks, and streams replies. This external attachment still performs context assembly for the normal chat path.
notes: Headless and chat now share body-owned WorkspaceContext. Relocated read-file inference passed on 2026-10-01; other faculties need separate verification.
UI panels, individual tools, synchronization and other detachable tooling are outside this map.

nova_runtime.label: Runtime
nova_runtime.summary: Owns the wake loop, event bus, transcript view, model dispatch, model guard, memory indexer, model-server control and adapter equip mechanism.

nova_cortex.label: Cortex
nova_cortex.summary: Builds reflection and decision prompts, applies actions to the task board, tracks drives, checks evidence, identifies speakers and chooses specialist loadouts.

nova_voice.label: Voice and action router
nova_voice.summary: Calls the language model, handles reasoning and response channels, recognizes action requests, dispatches them, and runs evidence checks before the reply is committed.

nova_senses.label: Senses
nova_senses.summary: Reads time, presence, environment, interaction state, hardware/UI state, images and web information. Host-screen vision and the separate Linux desktop are distinct paths.

nova_lancedb.label: Searchable memory
nova_lancedb.summary: Queues chat and image entries, embeds them, stores them in local LanceDB tables, and returns bounded text excerpts for automatic or deliberate recall.

nova_logs.label: Logging and retention
nova_logs.summary: Provides logging helpers and retention policy. Some faculties also write dedicated receipts directly; this package is not the sole writer of all records.

nova_imagination.label: Imagination
nova_imagination.summary: Builds image workflows, selects checkpoints and LoRAs, submits work to ComfyUI and collects output. Service availability is separate from code wiring.

nova_forge.label: Forge
nova_forge.summary: Discovers, classifies, loads and tests created capabilities. The discovery and dispatch boundary is mapped; individual created tools are excluded.

nova_play.label: Play
nova_play.summary: Selects unexpected material, including a random encyclopedia topic, and saves chosen curios to a shelf.

nova_computer.label: Computer faculty
nova_computer.summary: Defines a backend-neutral computer, selects local Linux or WSL, and offers shell and GUI actions through Hands. Standalone setup/diagnostic entry points also live here.
notes: Incoming imports are shown explicitly. No normal chat/action-router connection to Hands was established in the initial source review.
Host vision uses a separate capture path. A shared name such as eyes does not establish VM display wiring.

nova_memory.label: Journal and state helpers
nova_memory.summary: Provides append-only journaling, goal proposals, log reading and precondition helpers. The main router currently writes journal files directly; this package is distinct from LanceDB.

nova_config.label: Config helper
nova_config.summary: Defines a configuration loader and fallback defaults. An existing package or configuration file does not establish that the running paths consume it.

nova_witness.label: Witness evaluation
nova_witness.summary: Contains golden-case extraction and replay utilities, not the live witness faculty. Live witness decisions are implemented in nova_cortex/witness.py.

nova_start.py.label: Stack launcher
nova_start.py.summary: Chooses local executables, starts model services and NovaLauncher, then opens the controller. This is the normal stack entry point.

general_tools/NovaLauncher.py.label: Runtime host bootstrap
general_tools/NovaLauncher.py.summary: Sets NOVA_WORKSPACE, installs a shared body runtime before importing the server, and hosts the chat attachment on port 8765.

general_tools/nova_chat/runtime_host.py.label: Alternate runtime-first boot
general_tools/nova_chat/runtime_host.py.summary: Creates and registers a NovaRuntime before attaching the FastAPI chat app. It retains the chat application's rich autonomy callbacks.

general_tools/nova_chat/server.py.label: Chat and callback boundary
general_tools/nova_chat/server.py.summary: Accepts HTTP/WebSocket messages, mediates access, builds context, supplies autonomy callbacks, calls model dispatch, indexes messages and publishes UI output. Individual tool endpoints are not expanded in the architecture diagram.

general_tools/nova_chat/workspace_contex.label: Context assembly
general_tools/nova_chat/workspace_contex.summary: Compatibility import forwarding the detachable face to body-owned context assembly.

general_tools/nova_chat/transcript.py.label: Chat transcript
general_tools/nova_chat/transcript.py.summary: Appends session messages to JSONL and formats conversation plus workspace context into model messages.

general_tools/nova_chat/session_manager..label: Session boundary
general_tools/nova_chat/session_manager..summary: Creates and switches chat sessions, manages session metadata and compresses inactive transcript files.

general_tools/nova_chat/nova_bridge.py.label: Directive bridge
general_tools/nova_chat/nova_bridge.py.summary: Parses structured directives from responses and translates supported directives into body/task operations. Shows the attachment seam, not each detachable tool.

nova_body/nova_runtime/runtime.py.label: NovaRuntime
nova_body/nova_runtime/runtime.py.summary: Coordinates boot, perception, the memory worker and the reflect-decide-act wake cycle. Host callbacks supply conversation and generation; headless boot uses the shared body-owned grounding builder.

nova_body/nova_runtime/__main__.py.label: Headless entry
nova_body/nova_runtime/__main__.py.summary: Adds body/workspace import roots and runs NovaRuntime without a chat application.

nova_body/nova_runtime/__init__.py.label: Runtime package
nova_body/nova_runtime/__init__.py.summary: Package entry for Nova's runtime and lifecycle machinery.

nova_body/nova_runtime/event_bus.py.label: Event bus
nova_body/nova_runtime/event_bus.py.summary: Publishes lifecycle events into bounded asyncio subscriber queues. With no attached subscriber, the body does not need a UI to accept its events.

nova_body/nova_runtime/model_client.py.label: Model dispatch
nova_body/nova_runtime/model_client.py.summary: Registers a response client and forwards generation arguments and output callbacks. The registered Nova client performs the actual model request.

nova_body/nova_runtime/model_guard.py.label: Generation guard
nova_body/nova_runtime/model_guard.py.summary: Tracks repeated model failures and rate/backoff limits to prevent uncontrolled retries.

nova_body/nova_runtime/llama_control.py.label: Model process control
nova_body/nova_runtime/llama_control.py.summary: Checks the local model service and provides start/stop/restart operations through injected or default operating-system hooks.

nova_body/nova_runtime/koels_equip.py.label: Adapter equip mechanism
nova_body/nova_runtime/koels_equip.py.summary: Persists desired specialist adapters, adjusts loaded adapter scales over HTTP, and coordinates restart-based loadout changes through LlamaControl.

nova_body/nova_runtime/transcript_store..label: Runtime transcript view
nova_body/nova_runtime/transcript_store..summary: Reads persistent conversation records and tracks which human messages have already been attended to.

nova_body/nova_cortex/__init__.py.label: Cortex package
nova_body/nova_cortex/__init__.py.summary: Package entry for executive, tasking and context faculties.

nova_body/nova_cortex/executive.py.label: Executive decisions
nova_body/nova_cortex/executive.py.summary: Maintains autonomy state; builds reflection, decision and execution prompts; applies structured decisions and records progress or rest.

nova_body/nova_cortex/tasking.py.label: Task board
nova_body/nova_cortex/tasking.py.summary: Reads and updates the id-keyed task board, including status, priorities and progress. Completed and abandoned tasks remain records.

nova_body/nova_cortex/integrity.py.label: Integrity and receipts
nova_body/nova_cortex/integrity.py.summary: Parses action calls, records actual results, retrieves receipts and reconciles demonstrated work with the task board.

nova_body/nova_cortex/witness.py.label: Live witness
nova_body/nova_cortex/witness.py.summary: Builds present-tense evidence, flags checkable claims, prepares audit prompts, interprets verdicts and records witness pipeline events.

nova_body/nova_cortex/discourse.py.label: Conversation grounding
nova_body/nova_cortex/discourse.py.summary: Determines what is happening in the conversation, who is present, and whether a response belongs in the room; includes recent actions as grounding.

nova_body/nova_cortex/drives.py.label: Drives and novelty
nova_body/nova_cortex/drives.py.summary: Maintains boredom, wants and novelty feedback that influence what Nova chooses to do during autonomous wakes.

nova_body/nova_cortex/principals.py.label: Speaker identity and trust
nova_body/nova_cortex/principals.py.summary: Classifies known principals, checks capabilities and validates untrusted input. The server enforces this body-owned policy at its boundary.

nova_body/nova_cortex/loadout.py.label: Specialist selection
nova_body/nova_cortex/loadout.py.summary: Reads KoELS manifests and makes pure loadout decisions from task text. Physical adapter changes belong to the runtime equip mechanism.

nova_body/nova_cortex/tunables.py.label: Live settings registry
nova_body/nova_cortex/tunables.py.summary: Reads and validates tunable inference and behavior settings from the administrative JSON store, with cached reads and defaults.

nova_body/nova_cortex/context_builder.py.label: Context sizing helpers
nova_body/nova_cortex/context_builder.py.summary: Provides lightweight token estimates and context budget helpers; references indicate which paths actually use them.

nova_body/nova_cortex/checkin.py.label: Check-in helper
nova_body/nova_cortex/checkin.py.summary: Checks for human interruptions or instructions between actions. Its presence alone is not proof that the normal response loop invokes it.

nova_body/nova_cortex/nova_status.py.label: Status writer
nova_body/nova_cortex/nova_status.py.summary: Writes Nova's status record for external observers.

nova_body/nova_cortex/rules.py.label: Operational rules
nova_body/nova_cortex/rules.py.summary: Contains operating-rule text and access helpers. Import evidence, not its legacy bootstrap description, determines its mapped consumers.

nova_body/nova_voice/__init__.py.label: Voice package
nova_body/nova_voice/__init__.py.summary: Package boundary for the body-owned model response loop and action dispatcher.

nova_body/nova_voice/nova.py.label: Response and evidence loop
nova_body/nova_voice/nova.py.summary: Assembles model messages, streams local inference, recognizes action calls in content/thinking, feeds results back, and runs witness checks before returning a reply.

nova_body/nova_voice/tool_router.py.label: Body action dispatcher
nova_body/nova_voice/tool_router.py.summary: Dispatches model-requested operations through body faculties and external tools, leaves receipts, and directly implements journal and recall entry points. Individual tool internals are excluded from this map.

nova_body/nova_lancedb/__init__.py.label: Memory package
nova_body/nova_lancedb/__init__.py.summary: Package entry for embedding, storage and background ingestion.

nova_body/nova_lancedb/indexer.py.label: Memory ingestion queue
nova_body/nova_lancedb/indexer.py.summary: Runs a worker thread that takes queued chat/image entries and passes them to the persistent store.

nova_body/nova_lancedb/hippocampus.py.label: Hippocampus store
nova_body/nova_lancedb/hippocampus.py.summary: Opens local LanceDB tables, stores text and image embeddings, applies similarity-based retention and formats bounded recall excerpts.

nova_body/nova_lancedb/embedder.py.label: Embedding models
nova_body/nova_lancedb/embedder.py.summary: Lazily loads MiniLM for text and CLIP for images. Converts inputs into vectors; failed embedding operations currently return zero vectors.

nova_body/nova_senses/__init__.py.label: Senses package
nova_body/nova_senses/__init__.py.summary: Package entry for perception modules. Individual imports provide current wiring evidence; the package's old scaffold comments are not authoritative.

nova_body/nova_senses/clock.py.label: Clock
nova_body/nova_senses/clock.py.summary: Reads real time and supports timed wake decisions.

nova_body/nova_senses/environment.py.label: Environment changes
nova_body/nova_senses/environment.py.summary: Observes watched paths and changes in Nova's surroundings for wake/perception context.

nova_body/nova_senses/touch.py.label: Interaction state
nova_body/nova_senses/touch.py.summary: Tracks who or what is interacting with Nova and which surfaces are active.

nova_body/nova_senses/presence.py.label: Presence
nova_body/nova_senses/presence.py.summary: Observes whether another participant is present instead of inferring presence from old conversation text.

nova_body/nova_senses/proprioception.py.label: System and UI inspection
nova_body/nova_senses/proprioception.py.summary: Inspects host application windows, UI elements and system state for higher-level sensing.

nova_body/nova_senses/eyes.py.label: Host vision coordinator
nova_body/nova_senses/eyes.py.summary: Combines host UI inspection, screenshot capture and local image understanding. This does not establish a connection to the separate Linux Hands display.

nova_body/nova_senses/vision.py.label: Host screenshot vision
nova_body/nova_senses/vision.py.summary: Captures the host screen with pyautogui and sends image requests to the local vision-capable model endpoint.

nova_body/nova_senses/sight.py.label: Image understanding
nova_body/nova_senses/sight.py.summary: Resolves and shrinks image inputs, calls the local multimodal endpoint and records what was actually viewed.

nova_body/nova_senses/web.py.label: Web perception
nova_body/nova_senses/web.py.summary: Searches or reads external web material and returns it through the body's perception interface.

nova_body/nova_senses/quiet_part_watcher.label: Unused-faculty watcher
nova_body/nova_senses/quiet_part_watcher.summary: Inspects activity evidence for capabilities that have stopped being used and surfaces those gaps.

nova_body/nova_senses/stretch.py.label: Stretch reminder sense
nova_body/nova_senses/stretch.py.summary: Observes prolonged inactivity and prepares a stretch-related reach-out. The runtime also contains a separately loaded created watcher, shown as a dynamic boundary.

nova_body/nova_computer/computer.py.label: Computer interface
nova_body/nova_computer/computer.py.summary: Selects a backend and exposes shell, lifecycle and snapshot operations while keeping backend details behind one interface.

nova_body/nova_computer/backends.py.label: Linux and WSL backends
nova_body/nova_computer/backends.py.summary: Implements probing and operations for local POSIX, WSL and unavailable-backend cases.

nova_body/nova_computer/hands.py.label: Hands on display :1
nova_body/nova_computer/hands.py.summary: Uses the computer's shell channel to run scrot and xdotool on a separate X display for screenshots and GUI actions.

nova_body/nova_computer/first_boot.py.label: Computer setup entry
nova_body/nova_computer/first_boot.py.summary: Standalone provisioning entry point for the computer environment; not a normal chat callback.

nova_body/nova_computer/pluck_check.py.label: Computer isolation checks
nova_body/nova_computer/pluck_check.py.summary: Standalone diagnostic for imports and backend behavior. Diagnostics are not evidence that the main response loop is wired to Hands.

nova_body/nova_computer/reach.py.label: Host access setup
nova_body/nova_computer/reach.py.summary: Configures the WSL computer's access to host files and Windows interoperability.

nova_body/nova_computer/toolkit.py.label: Guest toolkit setup
nova_body/nova_computer/toolkit.py.summary: Standalone setup utility that installs software into the guest computer.

nova_body/nova_computer/tune_up.py.label: Guest repair utility
nova_body/nova_computer/tune_up.py.summary: Standalone repair and diagnostic pass for guest account, display and authentication issues.

nova_body/nova_imagination/imagination.p.label: ComfyUI client
nova_body/nova_imagination/imagination.p.summary: Builds and submits image workflows, polls results, manages model resources and retrieves created images.

nova_body/nova_imagination/palette.py.label: Image-model palette
nova_body/nova_imagination/palette.py.summary: Describes available visual mediums/checkpoints and helps select an appropriate image-generation setup.

nova_body/nova_forge/__init__.py.label: Capability workshop
nova_body/nova_forge/__init__.py.summary: Requires designs, resolves body/tool locations, dynamically loads created modules and tracks their tests before dispatch.

nova_body/nova_play/curio.py.label: Curiosity engine
nova_body/nova_play/curio.py.summary: Selects surprising material from local/external sources and saves chosen curios to a shelf.

nova_body/nova_memory/__init__.py.label: Legacy memory package
nova_body/nova_memory/__init__.py.summary: Package entry for journal, goal, state and log-reading helpers, separate from vector memory.

nova_body/nova_memory/journal.py.label: Journal append helper
nova_body/nova_memory/journal.py.summary: Provides safe append operations for journal records; compare incoming references with the router's separate journal implementation.

nova_body/nova_memory/goals.py.label: Goal proposal helper
nova_body/nova_memory/goals.py.summary: Prepares goal/status changes using a proposal workflow rather than directly replacing the status document.

nova_body/nova_memory/log_reader.py.label: Session log reader
nova_body/nova_memory/log_reader.py.summary: Reads previous session logs and supports reviewing actual events and failures.

nova_body/nova_memory/state.py.label: Action preconditions
nova_body/nova_memory/state.py.summary: Checks state preconditions for actions; the map shows whether callers use this helper.

nova_body/nova_config/__init__.py.label: Config defaults loader
nova_body/nova_config/__init__.py.summary: Loads nova_config.json and supplies fallback defaults. No ordinary import consumer was found in the initial mapped inventory.

nova_body/nova_logs/__init__.py.label: Logging package
nova_body/nova_logs/__init__.py.summary: Package entry for log writers and retention helpers.

nova_body/nova_logs/logger.py.label: Log writer
nova_body/nova_logs/logger.py.summary: Writes categorized application records and generates its logging index.

nova_body/nova_logs/retention.py.label: Log retention
nova_body/nova_logs/retention.py.summary: Applies retention/rotation rules to supported log files so they do not grow without bounds.

nova_body/nova_witness/extract_golden.py.label: Golden-case extraction
nova_body/nova_witness/extract_golden.py.summary: Reads recorded witness events and extracts cases for later evaluation.

nova_body/nova_witness/replay.py.label: Witness replay harness
nova_body/nova_witness/replay.py.summary: Replays recorded audit cases against a specified inference endpoint. This is an evaluation entry point, not the live witness loop.

nova_body/nova_cortex/workspace_context..label: Context assembly
nova_body/nova_cortex/workspace_context..summary: Body-owned grounding: loads self-model, memory and mentioned files for both chat and headless execution.

resources.label: Local language / vision model
resources.summary: Separate inference process. The voice and vision faculties submit model requests; runtime controls health and adapter operations. A listening port does not prove successful inference.

resources.label: Image generation service
resources.summary: Optional separate image-generation process, called by the imagination faculty. The environment may override its URL.

resources.label: Linux desktop / noVNC
resources.summary: Separate GUI environment operated through the computer backend. noVNC is the viewing boundary; Hands uses shell commands, not the noVNC HTTP API.

resources.label: LanceDB files
resources.summary: Text and visual vector tables in nova_memory_db. Database contents are not embedded in this map.

resources.label: Self and written memory
resources.summary: Identity, current context, personal notes and journal files. Only location/metadata is represented here, never their private contents.

resources.label: Persistent body state
resources.summary: Autonomy, drives, touch and other state files managed by body faculties.

resources.label: Task board file
resources.summary: Durable task ids, statuses, priorities and progress records.

resources.label: Transcripts and receipts
resources.summary: Chat sessions, performed-action receipts and witness traces. Metadata only; no log contents are served by the map.

resources.label: KoELS / model assets
resources.summary: Specialist manifests drive loadout decisions. Model binaries and adapters remain outside the map's read surface.

resources.label: Configuration definitions
resources.summary: Settings schema/defaults and live tuning storage. Values may be overridden by environment or runtime configuration.

resources.label: Detachable / created tools
resources.summary: Shows only calls crossing to general_tools or dynamically loaded created modules, including optional external second opinions. Individual tools and their internals are intentionally excluded.

resources.label: External web
resources.summary: External information sources requested by the web/curiosity faculties. Browsing is not exercised by this map.

resources.label: Chat HTTP / WebSocket
resources.summary: FastAPI chat listener, hosted with the shared NovaRuntime in the normal launcher process. HTTP routes and /ws connect the conversation interface to the body. This port is a transport boundary, not a separate body faculty.

resources.label: Optional witness model
resources.summary: The launcher can start a separate small-model inference process. In this checkout the live voice/witness loop still uses the main model request helper; a dedicated 8081 process being available does not establish that the live auditor uses it. The replay harness accepts a chosen endpoint.

nodes.label: You
nodes.description: You start a conversation through a window. The window passes your message into Nova and shows the reply as it arrives.

nodes.label: Conversation window
nodes.description: The conversation window gathers the current discussion, written background and relevant memories. It hands that context to the body and displays what comes back.

nodes.label: Senses
nodes.description: These parts gather observations, such as time, activity and visual information. An observation gives Nova something to consider; it does not itself make a decision.

nodes.label: Self-direction
nodes.description: Nova can wake without a new message. The body reflects on the situation, chooses whether something needs doing, and may ask the model to work on it.

nodes.label: Memory
nodes.description: Nova has readable memory files and a searchable archive. The archive converts text or images into numbers for finding related past material. The code selects short excerpts and adds them to a model request; the model does not directly browse the database. This part opens the searchable archive implementation.

nodes.label: Thinking and reply loop
nodes.description: The language model generates a proposed response. The surrounding body supplies context, interprets requested actions, and checks claims against available evidence before delivering a reply.

nodes.label: Replies and actions
nodes.description: A response may request an action. The body sends it to the appropriate capability, collects the result as evidence, and lets the response loop continue. Some conversation material is also queued for memory.

nodes.label: Separate computer
nodes.description: Nova has a separate computer environment and code that can operate its screen, mouse and keyboard. This map has not established a normal conversation-to-computer connection in the inspected code.

journeys.label: A message becomes a reply
journeys.description: Follow the chat attachment through context assembly, generation, evidence checks and the returned reply.

journeys.label: Nova wakes on her own
journeys.description: The runtime asks the executive for reflection, then a decision, and optionally an execution step. The chat host supplies the generation callback in the attached configuration.

journeys.label: Save and recall a memory
journeys.description: New chat/image material enters a background queue. Automatic or requested recall embeds the query and returns a short archive block. Written memory follows a separate file path.

journeys.label: Check a claim against evidence
journeys.description: The response loop consults the live witness and actual action receipts. Optional heavy second opinions cross a dynamically loaded external boundary.

journeys.label: Understand the two visual paths
journeys.description: Host screenshots are sent to the local vision model. Hands separately sends shell commands to the Linux X display. The map deliberately does not invent a connection between them.

journeys.label: Choose and equip a specialist
journeys.description: The cortex reads manifests and decides a loadout. The runtime persists desired state and adjusts adapters or coordinates a model restart.
